nl_query: Show me all actors
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM actor

nl_query: List all film titles and their rental rates
gold_sql: SELECT title, rental_rate FROM film

nl_query: Show me all films rated PG-13
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG-13'

nl_query: What are all the category names?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM category

nl_query: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer

nl_query: Show all active staff members
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM staff WHERE active = TRUE

nl_query: What is the longest film?
gold_sql: SELECT title, length FROM film ORDER BY length DESC LIMIT 1

nl_query: List all countries sorted alphabetically
gold_sql: SELECT country FROM country ORDER BY country

nl_query: What languages are available?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM language

nl_query: How many films have an R rating?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'R'

nl_query: List all films with their language names
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, l.name AS language FROM film f JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id

nl_query: Show all customers and the city they live in
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ci.city FROM customer c JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id

nl_query: How many films are in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name

nl_query: What is the average rental rate per film rating?
gold_sql: SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating

nl_query: List all films that actor Penelope Guiness appears in
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'Penelope' AND a.last_name = 'Guiness'

nl_query: Show the number of customers per store
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id

nl_query: Which staff member processed the most rentals?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM staff s JOIN rental r ON s.staff_id = r.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY rental_count DESC LIMIT 1

nl_query: List all rentals that have not been returned yet
gold_sql: SELECT r.rental_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, r.rental_date FROM rental r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.return_date IS NULL

nl_query: What is the total payment amount by each customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name

nl_query: Find the top 5 most rented films
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY rental_count DESC LIMIT 5

nl_query: Show the total revenue per film category
gold_sql: SELECT cat.name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM category cat JOIN film_category fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

nl_query: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT co.country, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM country co JOIN city ci ON co.country_id = ci.country_id JOIN address a ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN customer c ON a.address_id = c.address_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

nl_query: Find actors who appeared in more than 3 films
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name HAVING COUNT(fa.film_id) > 3

nl_query: List the top 3 customers who spent the most money, along with their city and country
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ci.city, co.country, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, ci.city, co.country ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 3

nl_query: Show the average film length per category, only for categories with more than 3 films
gold_sql: SELECT cat.name, AVG(f.length) AS avg_length, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM category cat JOIN film_category fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY cat.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

nl_query: Find films that were rented but never returned
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE r.return_date IS NULL

nl_query: What is the monthly revenue trend for 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(p.payment_date) AS yr, MONTH(p.payment_date) AS mo, SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_revenue FROM payment p WHERE YEAR(p.payment_date) = 2023 GROUP BY yr, mo ORDER BY yr, mo

nl_query: For each store, show the most popular film category by number of rentals
gold_sql: SELECT ranked.store_id, ranked.category_name, ranked.rental_count FROM (SELECT s.store_id, cat.name AS category_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_id ORDER BY COUNT(r.rental_id) DESC) AS rn FROM store s JOIN inventory i ON s.store_id = i.store_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id GROUP BY s.store_id, cat.name) ranked WHERE ranked.rn = 1

nl_query: Find customers who have rented films from every category
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fc.category_id) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category)

nl_query: Rank actors by the total revenue their films have generated
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

nl_query: Find the average time between rental and return for each film rating, and compare it to the overall average
gold_sql: SELECT f.rating, AVG(DATEDIFF(r.return_date, r.rental_date)) AS avg_days, AVG(DATEDIFF(r.return_date, r.rental_date)) - (SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(r2.return_date, r2.rental_date)) FROM rental r2 WHERE r2.return_date IS NOT NULL) AS diff_from_overall FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.rating

nl_query: Show the cumulative revenue per store over time, by month
gold_sql: SELECT store_month.store_id, store_month.yr, store_month.mo, store_month.monthly_amount, SUM(store_month.monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_month.store_id ORDER BY store_month.yr, store_month.mo) AS cumulative_revenue FROM (SELECT s.store_id, YEAR(p.payment_date) AS yr, MONTH(p.payment_date) AS mo, SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_amount FROM store s JOIN staff st ON s.store_id = st.store_id JOIN payment p ON st.staff_id = p.staff_id GROUP BY s.store_id, yr, mo) store_month ORDER BY store_month.store_id, store_month.yr, store_month.mo
